items.headline: Chiefs' Patrick Mahomes earns 100th win in 131st start, tying Tom Brady
items.description: Quarterback Patrick Mahomes earned his 100th win with the Chiefs in his 131st regular-season start Sunday, tying Tom Brady for the fewest games needed to reach 100 career wins.

items.headline: Chiefs move to 5-0 as Kenneth Walker runs for two TDs in a 22-6 win over Chargers
items.description: — Patrick Mahomes hadn't watched the tape of the Chiefs' game against the Los Angeles Chargers from last December — that game in which he tore ligaments in his left knee and Kansas City was eliminated from postseason contention — until just this week.
